Confirmed defects

QA-001 - Pool filter does not narrow results

high P1

Category: Functional

Severity rationale: Users searching for pool stays are shown non-pool properties, causing incorrect booking choices.

Priority rationale: Core discovery filter is misleading in primary browse journey.

Impact: Reduced trust in search filters and higher risk of wrong property selection.

Expected

Only properties with pool amenities remain visible

Explicit filter semantics in UI

Actual

Properties labelled 'No swimming pool' remain visible after filter activation

Filter control state changed to pressed and backend query used pool=true, but card set did not match

Steps

  • Open homepage list section
  • Click 'With a pool' filter chip
  • Inspect resulting property cards

Attempts: 2 | Reproduced: 2

Evidence: EV-001 EV-002

Hypothesis / details

Possible causes

  • Filter state not applied when rendering card subset
  • Backend pool parameter ignored or mismatched with UI attributes

Recommendation: Align pool filter logic with displayed amenity flag and add assertion tests for negative amenities.

QA-002 - The Anda card secondary CTA routes to Serena Villas

high P1

Category: Functional

Severity rationale: User intent is redirected to a different property from the selected card.

Priority rationale: Direct conversion CTA misroutes on a top card in primary browsing surface.

Impact: Users may book the wrong listing and lose confidence in navigation integrity.

Expected

CTA destination matches The Anda card identity

Card title link and CTA should represent same listing

Actual

Destination page is Serena Villas (/#/hotel/serena-villas)

The Anda title link itself routes correctly to /#/hotel/the-anda

Steps

  • Locate The Anda card
  • Click its secondary CTA 'Explore stay ↗'
  • Observe destination page title and URL

Attempts: 2 | Reproduced: 2

Evidence: EV-003 EV-004

Hypothesis / details

Possible causes

  • Incorrect href binding for first card CTA template

Recommendation: Bind CTA target from current card record and add link-consistency test per card.
